This report tests the ODBC integration on this content from the content runtime.
To test again after you change the integration or the runtime, render the report again.

```{python}
#| output: asis
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import platform

import odbc_check

results = odbc_check.run_checks()
failed = [r for r in results if r.status == odbc_check.FAIL]

if failed:
    print("::: {.callout-important}\n## The test failed\n")
    print("Fix the first failed check, then render the report again.\n:::\n")
else:
    print("::: {.callout-tip}\n## The test passed\n")
    print("Content that uses this integration can connect to the database.\n:::\n")

labels = {odbc_check.PASS: "Passed", odbc_check.FAIL: "Failed", odbc_check.SKIP: "Skipped"}
for r in results:
    print("## %s: %s\n" % (r.title, labels[r.status]))
    print(r.message + "\n")
    for d in r.details:
        print("- " + d)
    print()
    if r.output:
        print("```text\n%s\n```\n" % r.output)

print("## Runtime\n")
print("- Python %s on %s" % (platform.python_version(), platform.platform()))
print("- Rendered at %s UTC" % datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
```
